identity.coverageNote: Complete source-defined deferent duct surface, not a validated continuous lumen or complete spermatic cord. Epididymis, ejaculatory duct, fascial coverings and neurovascular contents are not supplied by this addition. Original coordinates and faces retained; clinical review pending.

anatomy.title: Left deferent duct · Source anatomy · draft
anatomy.body: The deferent duct (ductus or vas deferens) is a muscular duct that continues from the epididymis, passes through the inguinal canal and reaches the posterior bladder region. Its terminal portion joins the seminal-vesicle duct to form the ejaculatory duct.
bullets: Use Study → Male pelvis: deferent ducts to compare the supplied surfaces and nearby organs.
Epididymides, ejaculatory ducts, cord coverings and nerves are not supplied by this addition; do not infer a complete connection from surface proximity.
anatomy.note: Source-bound teaching draft for radiologist review. Complete source files do not establish complete anatomical extent, a continuous lumen or patient correspondence.
